title: Closeness at an imperfectly laid table

captions.physics: Creating a warm setting for leisure
captions.energy: Waiting for every detail to fit

meaning: Pleasure opens through closeness when the wish to assemble a flawless evening leaves room to enjoy each other’s presence.
text: You can create a great deal for a pleasant evening: beautiful food, a comfortable place and details worth noticing. This is the Empress in the physical position of Svadhisthana, giving shared enjoyment a tangible form. The World in energy is vulnerable to waiting for complete readiness. Everything must fit before leisure is allowed to begin. The Lovers in emotions reveal another source of delight, mutual openness and attraction. Created beauty can support closeness, while the demand for a perfect whole sometimes makes you miss its simple expressions already available now.

Suppose you lay a dinner table for two. The intended tablecloth is missing, candles differ in size and the food is ready. **Your meeting needs no finished decoration.** You can sit down, share the first flavour and hear about each other’s day. Even the amusing mismatch of dishes can become part of the enjoyment. Attention brings the evening together although several intended details remain on the list.

The difficulty is considering rest premature while a single mismatch remains. You keep arranging beauty, and the closeness you invited waits outside the preparations. Wanting to share something pleasant becomes a demand to finish everything first. The other person must either help with endless preparation or feel like an interruption. Fullness can arise through participation without perfecting the surroundings to an imagined final touch.
